For confirmation **LL0EZ6** / **FLT-123** (San Francisco SFO → Los Angeles LAX on 2024-12-09):

I checked policy — for lengthy delays we do provide hotel and meal vouchers plus ground transport, and if a delay is over 3 hours or causes a missed connection we open a compensation case.

However I was **not able to issue** hotel/meal vouchers for this request:

* Your booking on record is SFO → LAX and is currently **On time and operating as scheduled** (Gate A10, 16:10 → 17:35) — it is not showing as disrupted.
* Compensation vouchers can only be issued when the booking itself is disrupted. Your description of a missed connection in New York on the way to Austin does not match this SFO-LAX booking.
* No case was opened, and no vouchers were issued, so there are no receipts to keep at this time.

If your New York → Austin missed connection is on a **different confirmation**, please share that confirmation number and I can help you with that booking separately.
